Yasmin: Hi team — trying to finish onboarding but stuck on a couple things. When I try to enroll a passkey in Okta it gives a device-trust error. Also haven't received my 1Password invite. Anyone who-to-ask?
Ava (IT): Hey Yasmin — can you paste the exact error? Is this on macOS or iOS?
Yasmin: macOS Ventura. Error dialog says: 'Device trust check failed: cta=unverified_device'. Tried rebooting.
Marco (EngBuddy): hey @Yasmin, I had something similar last week — for me the device time mismatch caused it. Check System Settings → Date & Time.
Yasmin: time is correct. Also I ran `sudo /usr/sbin/ntpdate -qu time.apple.com` and it returned reachable.
okta-bot: New device enrollment attempt recorded for yasmin@redwood.ai from device 'Yasmin-MBP' (macOS 13.4). Policy: passkey+device_trust.
Devon (SSO Admin): Thanks @Yasmin. I see a failed device-assertion in Okta logs around 11:02 PT: `device_trust_status=unknown`. Can you open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Tools and confirm there are no weird blocks? Also did you previously register a YubiKey or other passkey?
Yasmin: no hardware key. Fresh laptop. I did accept the prompt to allow Okta to create a passkey but it just bounced back.
Ava (IT): Also double-check the MDM enrollment — we expect the device to be managed. Is your laptop showing 'Managed by Redwood' in System Settings → General?
Yasmin: it shows managed. Profile installed.
Devon (SSO Admin): I'm going to force a re-evaluate of the device in Okta. @Ava can you confirm the device serial for Yasmin-MBP?
Ava (IT): serial: C02XYZ123456. Pushing a refresh now.
Devon (SSO Admin): Okta re-eval completed — status now `device_trust_status=registered`. Try enrolling the passkey again.
Yasmin: trying now... ok, the passkey prompt succeeded 🎉 — thanks!
Yasmin: still no 1Password invite though, tried searching spam.
Lena (People Ops): @Yasmin sorry about that — I see invite sent to yasmin@personal-email.com per HR sheet. Should be your work email?
Yasmin: ah — HR accidentally had personal email. My Redwood email is yasmin@redwood.ai.
Lena (People Ops): Fixing now. Resent invite to yasmin@redwood.ai. You should get an email from support+signup@1password.com.
Yasmin: got it! link works, creating account. Thanks all for the quick help :heart:
Marco (EngBuddy): Awesome — welcome aboard! Ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of dev laptop setup tomorrow.
Ava (IT): Leaving a note on the ticket: misconfigured HR email caused 1Password invite to personal address; we've patched the user record.
Devon (SSO Admin): Follow up: we'll monitor device trust for next 24h, but looks resolved. If the passkey fails again, add a screenshot and DM me.
Yasmin: will do. Thanks everyone :)
